silhouette.reason: Barracks, a squad of soldiers, a tank and a crystal deposit on one ground plate: the roster reads as one faction (bone/team red/amber), and every unit is identifiable in the 3/4 views. As a composition it is a line-up, not a base layout.
fixes: arrange the units with intent (squad in formation at the gate, tank parked on its path) and add a perimeter element such as a low wall or fence segment

proportions.reason: 30 x 25 x 11.2 m plate; all assets come in at true scale through ctx.use, soldiers fit the 3.5 m gate, tank ~3 soldiers long.
fixes: scale check against a real compound: a 30 x 25 m plate is tight for a barracks plus a tank park

materials.reason: Each asset keeps its strips; the ground plate meant as salt-flat sand reads as light wood planks (straight grain stripes) in hero.png, and the two paths are barely distinguishable from it.
fixes: ground plate on a sand/soil strip (not one with straight grain) with gravel paths that contrast in value and roughness (rts_faction.ts)

detail.reason: Hall, squad, tank and deposit on an empty plate with two paths; nothing ties them together (no crates, fuel drums, fences, signage, tyre tracks).
fixes: props between assets: crates, fuel drums, a sandbag line
tyre tracks from the tank park to the gate

wear.reason: Inherits each asset's weather(); the plate itself is clean, with no tracks, puddles or trampled ground around the gate.
fixes: grime() trampled darker ground at the gate and track ruts behind the tank

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 (3.66k tris) keeps every asset, colour block and the team red; the tank loses its wheels to a belt slab and soldiers become blocky.
fixes: keep the tank wheel discs at LOD2 (rts_tank running.ts) so the parked tank does not change outline

technical.reason: QA PASS (rebuilt today): 143k / 31.2k / 3.66k tris, 36 / 36 / 22 draws. Fine for a showcase, but 36 draws at LOD0 is heavy for a single placed asset.
fixes: merge static parts across the composed assets into one body per material so LOD0 drops well below 36 draws
